[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mingo Bovark]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] traveled to [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] in [[137 ABY]] aboard a''' ''Nune''-class Imperial shuttle'''. The [[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|shuttle's]] controls were later [[Slicer/Legends|overridden]] by four [[Command Override Limpet Droid]]s planted by [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], and the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Skirmish on The Wheel|fired upon]] a [[Unidentified Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|''Crix''-class diplomatic courier shuttle]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].
